work.title: Extract TerminalizationService
work.description: Move accept, rollback, archive coordination, the final manifest checkpoint, integration, terminal cleanup, and recovery-ref handling into TerminalizationService; Spec-driven cancel and supersede use the same domain finalization rules where applicable.
acceptance: All terminal outcomes share the same domain finalization logic
Active attempts become abandoned when terminalized externally
Cleanup failures remain retryable without reverting terminal state
